desc:
🐾 Welcome to Animal Restaurant [ANOMALY] 🍔🌙

Can you survive the night shift?

👀Cook tasty food, serve hungry animals, and keep the restaurant running until morning... but stay alert. 

Some guests are NOT what they seem.

🍳 HOW TO PLAY
🥩 Cook orders before customers lose patience
🍽️ Serve guests and keep the restaurant running
👀 Watch customers closely for strange behavior
🚨 Spot ANOMALIES before it's too late
💰 Earn cash and upgrade your restaurant
🌙 Work as long as possible!
🎉 2X WEEKENDS, Earn 2X rewards every weekend! 💸🔥

Bring your friends and see how long you can survive.

⭐ Enjoying the game? LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ to support future updates!
👥 Join our community for update news, sneak peeks, and bug reports!

⚠️ DISCLAIMER
Animal Restaurant is still in Alpha. Expect bugs, balancing changes, and occasional shutdowns while we update the game. Please report any bugs you find!

🐾 Inspired by Animal Hospital
